title: Every worker reports to the main that gave it work, and the app closes finished worker panes
notes:
Two things agents are told today and forget; the app should do them (user, 2026-11-09: rules out of CLAUDE.md and prompts, into the app).

1. Reporting. The app adds 'SendMessage to main-<project> when done' only on pane run (src/main/actions/pane/dispatch.ts:93 workerPrompt, when a dispatcher is known). Work that reaches a pane any other way carries no line and no dispatcher: pane send into an open pane (a New Claude, a pane the user started), a move into Ship, the review loop's agent. A kamandsystem worker (2026-11-09) finished a PR and told nobody, then said nothing marked the task as coming from another session.
   Change: whenever a main sends work into a pane (pane run, pane send, a ship, the review loop) the pane action records that main as the pane's dispatcher and adds the report line to that prompt. A Ship or review agent reports to its project's main. A pane the user opened stays silent until a main first sends it work. One decision (who a pane reports to, when the line is added) in the pane actions with tests; #241's stop-notice withdrawal and the false-notice rules apply to these panes too.

2. Closing. Mains are told to 'pane release <id>' once they have a worker's report and often do not; the user closes finished panes by hand.
   Change: the app releases a worker pane itself, through pane.release (actions-rule-1), when:
   - its card reaches Done or Cancelled (and, once card 07e3399d lands, when its PR merges, which moves the card to Done);
   - or it reported done, its turn ended with nothing running in the background, main has read the report, and nothing was sent to it for a grace period (e.g. 10 minutes; a setting).
   Never: a pane the user opened by hand and never handed to a main; a pane with the keyboard or zoomed; a worker blocked on a question or paused on its own background work. Release keeps a worktree with no PR as now. Each auto-release is logged with the reason and shown as a passing notice ('Closed pane 0:2: card done').
   The decision (release now, why, or why not) is one pure module with tests for every case above.

Docs: workers README and decisions (workers-decision-1 grows), panes README, history; main's dispatch instructions (dispatch.ts) drop 'release <id> close the pane once you have its report' to a note that the app does it. Engineering bar: clean, testable, readable, without creating bugs.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #258: pane send, ships and the review loop report to the main that sent the work, and the app releases finished worker panes (card Done/Cancelled, or report read plus workers.closeAfterMinutes idle) through pane.release, with a passing notice. Not done: a hand-opened screen handed work comes back as yours after a restart; a restored worker is not auto-closed until it stops again; no settings-screen row.
